scenario.title: 聊 IG、Threads 和網路文化
scenario.context: 聊社群時一直在描述看到、聽到的東西：「我看到她在發文」「我聽到有人在罵」。英文的感官動詞 see / hear / watch / notice 後面接原形或 V-ing，意思不太一樣，這是 B2 的經典考點。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did you see Leo's post? He's in Japan again.
lines.zh: 你有看到 Leo 的貼文嗎？他又去日本了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah. I saw him posting stories all night. Serious FOMO.
lines.zh: 有，我看到他整晚都在發限動，超怕錯過的焦慮。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: He's definitely flexing. That hotel costs a fortune.
lines.zh: 他絕對是在炫耀，那間飯店超貴。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Not really. I mostly lurk. I like watching other people share their lives.
lines.zh: 不太發，我大多潛水，喜歡看別人分享生活。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Same. Although for work, I have to post my illustrations every week.
lines.zh: 我也是。不過因為工作，我每週都得發插畫。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Right, your account is doing well! I saw a big brand repost you.
lines.zh: 對，你的帳號經營得不錯！我看到一個大品牌轉發你。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Did you hear about that influencer who got canceled?
lines.zh: 你有聽說那個被抵制的網紅嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I heard people talking about it, but I don't know the details.
lines.zh: 我有聽到大家在講，但不知道細節。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Someone noticed him copying another artist's work.
lines.zh: 有人發現他抄襲另一位藝術家的作品。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oof. That's a big deal in the art world.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: I watched the whole thing unfold in the comments. It was brutal.
lines.zh: 我在留言區看了整件事的發展，超殘酷。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Cancel culture can go too far, but plagiarism is serious.
lines.zh: 抵制文化有時太過頭，但抄襲是很嚴重的事。

patterns.zh: 你有看到 ___ 的貼文嗎？

patterns.en: I saw it on my feed.
I'm taking a break from social media.
I spend way too much time on my phone.
patterns.zh: 我花太多時間在手機上了。

chinglish.wrong: I saw him to post a photo.
chinglish.right: I saw him post a photo. / I saw him posting a photo.
chinglish.why: 感官動詞後面接原形或 V-ing，不加 to。

chinglish.wrong: I heard someone scolded him on the internet.
chinglish.right: I heard people criticizing him online.
chinglish.why: 感官動詞 hear + 人 + V-ing；「在網路上」說 online。scold 是罵小孩的「責罵」，網路批評用 criticize。

chinglish.wrong: I am a diving person on IG.
chinglish.why: 「潛水」直翻 dive 不通，英文說 lurk。

chinglish.wrong: He is showing off his rich.
chinglish.right: He's flexing. / He's showing off his wealth.
chinglish.why: rich 是形容詞，不能當 show off 的受詞。

grammar.title: 感官動詞 see / hear + V / V-ing
grammar.oneLiner: see / hear / watch / notice / feel + 受詞 + 原形（看到完整過程）或 V-ing（看到正在進行的片段）；不加 to。
whenToUse: + 原形：看到或聽到整個動作完成。I saw him post the photo.（從頭到尾）
+ V-ing：看到或聽到動作進行中的一部分。I saw him posting stories.（正在發）
常見感官動詞：see, hear, watch, notice, feel, smell（smell 通常接 V-ing）。
被動時要加 to：He was seen to leave.（正式，較少用）
hear about / hear of：聽說某事。I heard about the scandal.
注意和 make / let（第 24 單元）一樣，主動時後面不加 to。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「看到他發文」「聽到有人在罵」的動詞不用變形。英文感官動詞後面的動詞要用原形或 V-ing，台灣人常受 want to、need to 影響而加 to。另外，原形和 V-ing 的細微差別（完整 vs 片段）也很少被注意。

examples.correct: I saw her leave the party early.
examples.incorrect: I saw her to leave the party early.
examples.note: 感官動詞 + 原形，不加 to。

examples.correct: I heard someone singing in the next room.
We watched the sun set over the ocean.
Did you notice him looking at his phone the whole time?

quiz.question: I heard people ___ about it in the café.

slang.meaning: 錯失恐懼症（怕錯過好玩的事）
slang.usage: fear of missing out。唸成 /ˈfoʊmoʊ/。反義 JOMO（joy of missing out）。

examples.en: Everyone's at the concert and I'm home. Major FOMO.
examples.zh: 大家都去演唱會，只有我在家，超怕錯過。

examples.en: I bought the ticket out of pure FOMO.
examples.zh: 我純粹是怕錯過才買票的。

slang.usage: 在社群或論壇只看不互動。名詞 lurker。

examples.en: I've been lurking in this group for years.
examples.zh: 我在這個社團潛水好幾年了。

examples.en: Hi, I'm usually a lurker, but I had to comment on this.
examples.zh: 嗨，我平常都潛水，但這篇我一定要留言。

slang.usage: 動詞 flex（炫耀）；名詞 a flex。Weird flex, but OK = 很奇怪的炫耀，但好吧。

risk.note: 年輕人和網路用語，帶一點調侃。

examples.en: He's always flexing his new cars on Instagram.
examples.zh: 他總是在 IG 上炫他的新車。

examples.en: Finishing all my emails before noon? That's a flex.
examples.zh: 中午前回完所有信？這值得炫耀。

slang.usage: get canceled = 因為爭議被群眾抵制。cancel culture = 抵制文化。

risk.note: 是有政治爭議的話題，討論時注意語氣，很容易引起對立。

examples.en: The comedian got canceled after his old tweets resurfaced.
examples.zh: 那個喜劇演員的舊推文被翻出來後就被抵制了。

examples.en: Some people think cancel culture has gone too far.
examples.zh: 有些人覺得抵制文化太過頭了。

review.question: ___ can be addictive.
review.explanation: 複習第 66 單元：泛指不加冠詞。

review.question: I turned off notifications so ___ I could focus.
review.explanation: 複習第 65 單元：so that + 子句。

review.question: ___ bothers me is how fake it all looks.
review.explanation: 複習第 59 單元：What 子句。

review.question: I ___ my follower count by 200% last year.
review.explanation: 複習第 51 單元：強動詞過去式。

review.question: You got 1,000 hateful comments? That ___ be awful.
review.explanation: 複習第 35 單元：must 推測。

review.question: I saw it ___ Instagram.
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元延伸：社群平台用 on。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: I saw her to post it.
